{
 "path": "programs/task-17f5503a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate full separator rows and columns by dominant nonzero color.
    sep_color = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v), key=lambda c: sum(x == c for row in grid for x in row))
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep_color for x in row)]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rs + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cs + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0,r1=rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]
        # each adjacent pair of cells complements by left-right reflection
        for ci in range(0,len(cb)-1,2):
            c0,c1=cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
            d0,d1=cb[ci+1]+1,cb[ci+2]
            a=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            b=[row[d0:d1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            hasa=any(x for row in a for x in row)
            hasb=any(x for row in b for x in row)
            if hasa and not hasb:
                for i in range(r1-r0):
                    for j in range(d1-d0): out[r0+i][d0+j]=a[i][(c1-c0)-1-j]
            elif hasb and not hasa:
                for i in range(r1-r0):
                    for j in range(c1-c0): out[r0+i][c0+j]=b[i][(d1-d0)-1-j]
    return out
"
